title: Forgiveness
introduction: Forgiveness is central to the gospel. God forgives us sinners completely in Christ and calls us to forgive others as he has forgiven us. Forgiveness breaks the chains of sin and sets free both the one who forgives and the one who is forgiven.

sections.title: God's forgiveness
sections.description: God forgives all our sins and casts them away forever.

sections.title: Forgiveness through Christ
sections.description: It is through Jesus' blood that we have forgiveness for our sins.

sections.title: Called to forgive
sections.description: As forgiven sinners, we are called to forgive others.

sections.title: Forgive - again and again
sections.description: Jesus calls us to unlimited forgiveness.

sections.title: The Prodigal Son
sections.description: The parable of the prodigal son shows God's heart for forgiveness.
